result.description: Shared inbox and customer support platform with a knowledge base (Docs), live chat and reporting.
result.auth_detail: Inbox (Mailbox) API v2: OAuth 2.0 with Authorization Code (for integrations used by other Help Scout users) and Client Credentials (internal). Docs API: per-user API key passed via HTTP Basic auth (key as username, dummy password).
result.access_detail: OAuth2 app created self-serve under Your Profile > My apps. But the Free plan has no API access. Standard/Plus/Pro include it (200/400/800 calls per minute). A 15-day no-card trial of Standard/Plus exists. I found no app-review requirement for Authorization Code apps.
result.api_notes: Inbox API v2 at api.helpscout.net/v2. Endpoint groups: Conversations, Customers, Inboxes, Organizations, Reports, Tags, Teams, Users, Webhooks, Workflows. Reporting endpoints need Plus or Pro. Separate Docs API (knowledge base) uses API keys. Rate limits depend on plan.
result.blocker: API needs a paid plan (Free has none). Reporting endpoints need Plus or Pro. The official MCP server is read-only.

evidence.quote: This is an HTTPS-only API and it uses OAuth 2.0 authorization, implementing Authorization Code and Client Credential flows.
The API key is passed via HTTP Basic Authentication and goes in the username field.
Create one by navigating to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App.
The Free plan does not include access to the API or integrations.
This is an HTTPS-only API, with OAuth 2 authentication and CORS support running at:
Set the remote MCP server URL to `https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp`
Want to trial the Pro plan? Talk to our sales team.
